macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street retreats as tech stocks and rising yields pressure markets
items.summary: U.S. stocks fell, led by a roughly 1.9% drop in the Nasdaq 100 and a 0.9% decline in the S&P 500, as megacap technology shares weakened amid concerns about OpenAI revenue and higher Treasury yields.[2]

items.title: Fed officials signal another rate hike may be needed
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said additional rate increases will likely be required if economic data remain on track, though the timing of hikes need not be consecutive. Recent Fed minutes likewise showed that most officials expect another increase this year.[1][3]

items.title: Oil surges above $105 as Middle East tensions intensify
items.summary: Brent crude rose more than 4% and moved above $105 per barrel amid concerns about potential escalation involving Iran, raising fears of renewed inflation and tighter monetary policy.[3][5]

items.title: Treasury yields reach multiyear highs
items.summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield climbed to about 5.34%, with rising energy prices and expectations for additional Fed tightening weighing on equities and credit-sensitive sectors.[5][6]

items.title: Asian and European stocks extend declines
items.summary: Asian markets fell after Wall Street’s retreat, while France’s CAC 40 dropped 0.5% to a seven-month low as higher oil prices, global bond yields and inflation concerns pressured equities.[6][7]

items.title: Samsung posts major profit growth but misses lofty expectations
items.summary: Samsung reported an almost ninefold increase in quarterly profit, but the result fell short of the market’s elevated expectations, sending its shares down about 2.4% in Seoul.[5]

items.title: PepsiCo beats revenue expectations
items.summary: PepsiCo reported third-quarter revenue of $25.27 billion, up 5.6% year over year and above Wall Street expectations, helped by global snack-food volume growth despite weaker North American demand.[3]

items.title: Datadog raises annual forecast after strong results
items.summary: Cloud security company Datadog raised its annual outlook after exceeding first-quarter expectations, citing strong demand for cloud-security products amid increased artificial-intelligence adoption.[10]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $81,000 as crypto liquidations approach $1 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $81,000, while Solana, Dogecoin, XRP and Ethereum also declined amid broader risk-asset pressure. CoinGlass data showed roughly $974 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours.

items.title: Bitcoin selloff triggers $1.02 billion liquidation cascade
items.summary: Bitcoin briefly fell to about $80,000, with 164,899 traders liquidated during the 24-hour period. Ethereum, XRP and Dogecoin were among the assets contributing to the liquidation wave.

items.title: Hong Kong regulator flags unlicensed crypto-related firms and platforms
items.summary: Hong Kong authorities reportedly listed Finanx AI as an unlicensed firm promoting FNXAI and 1FNXAI tokens, while officials said enforcement action could target unlicensed payment platforms.

items.title: France considers crypto tax and wallet-reporting measures
items.summary: France’s proposed 2027 budget includes amendments addressing stablecoin taxation and declarations for crypto wallets, potentially expanding reporting and tax obligations for digital-asset users.

items.title: Cardano spins out digital-identity project Veridian
items.summary: The Cardano Foundation is reportedly separating its Veridian digital-identity initiative into an independent legal entity, marking a new organizational phase for the project.

items.title: Extended plans settlement-network migration to Circle’s Arc
items.summary: Perpetual futures platform Extended announced plans to migrate its settlement network to Arc, Circle’s layer-1 blockchain designed for financial-market applications.

items.title: TRON plans tokenized-stock launch in Q4
items.summary: TRON is reportedly preparing to introduce tokenized stocks in the fourth quarter, reflecting continued expansion of blockchain-based representations of traditional assets.

items.title: U.S. government-linked Bitcoin transfers draw market attention
items.summary: Blockchain reports indicated that U.S. government-associated addresses moved roughly 12,000 BTC, while another report tracked about 264.863 BTC linked to the 2016 Bitfinex hack moving to Coinbase.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Forza Horizon 6 coming to PlayStation 5 in January 2027
items.summary: Xbox Game Studios and Playground Games announced that Forza Horizon 6 will launch on PlayStation 5 on January 26, 2027, alongside its first expansion and a free update. Premium Edition owners will receive earlier access.[1]

items.title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival released
items.summary: Saber Interactive released the horror game Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, with review coverage also published as the release embargo ended.[1]

items.title: Neon Abyss 2 exits early access
items.summary: Neon Abyss 2 received its full release, adding a final boss and new modes to its cooperative cyber-mythology roguelike experience for up to four players.[3]

items.title: Google and Unity introduce AI game-creation platforms
items.summary: Google and Unity presented Playground and Spark, experimental tools intended to let users create and develop simple games through natural-language interaction and generative AI.[1]

items.title: Waltz and Jam set for December release
items.summary: Flyway Games confirmed that Waltz and Jam will launch on PC, PlayStation 5, and Switch 2 on December 3, 2026; a Steam demo is currently available.[10]

items.title: Free Fire 2026 esports roadmap announced
items.summary: Garena unveiled its 2026 Free Fire esports plans, including expanded global participation and a new competition format.[2]

items.title: Asia Pacific Predator League 2026 concludes
items.summary: Fancy United Esports won the VALORANT competition and Myth Avenue Gaming won the Dota 2 competition at the Asia Pacific Predator League 2026.[2]

items.title: Steam projected to surpass $20 billion in 2026 revenue
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates that Steam could exceed $20 billion in annual revenue in 2026, citing strong performance during the first nine months of the year.[5]

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: Microsoft suspended from U.S. green-card program
items.summary: The Trump administration suspended Microsoft from a program used to sponsor green cards for H-1B workers, alleging fraud. Microsoft has disputed the allegations.
